summary: Star Bulk Carriers filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing Second Amended and Restated At-The-Market sales agreements dated October 9, 2026 with Deutsche Bank Securities and Jefferies, replacing a prior April 2022 agreement, alongside Seward Kissel validity opinions and a press release on ATM program renewal. The Deutsche Bank facility covers up to $41,371,110 in common shares, $0.01 par, sold from time to time as agent or principal. No price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. This is a routine shelf takedown/equity distribution mechanism, not a special situation; watch dilution and selling pace.
